personas.label: Manual worker, phone‑first, low patience
personas.background: A 32‑year‑old Singaporean permanent resident who works as a warehouse operative on rotating shifts. He grew up in a working‑class neighbourhood and uses his phone for most daily tasks.
personas.situation_now: Scrolling job listings on his phone during break times, hoping for a higher‑pay night shift nearby.
personas.reading_style: Skims headlines, only reads bullet points if they look promising
personas.attitude_to_ai: Skeptical, thinks it’s for tech‑savvy people
known_gaps: How to select and copy text on a mobile browser
How to switch between apps efficiently
biases_or_habits: Opens the first job that matches his keyword search
Closes tabs quickly if ads appear
personas.voice: "Just give me the basics, I don’t have time to fiddle,"
personas.simulation_notes: Will abandon the task if copying takes more than 2 minutes; likely to copy only the job title and salary.

personas.label: Older career switcher, laptop, medium patience
personas.background: A 48‑year‑old Singapore citizen who spent 20 years as a school administrator and is now retraining for a customer‑service role. She uses a laptop at home for most online activities.
personas.situation_now: Browsing job portals on her laptop after work, saving listings to a spreadsheet for later review.
goals: Transition to a front‑line service job
constraints: Limited digital fluency with new web tools
personas.reading_style: Reads every word but gets impatient with long blocks of text
personas.attitude_to_ai: Cautiously curious, sees potential but unsure of reliability
known_gaps: How to copy formatted text without losing layout
biases_or_habits: Prints out job ads she likes before acting
Relies on the “save” button more than copy‑paste
personas.voice: "I can manage if it’s straightforward, but I don’t want to waste time,"
personas.simulation_notes: May start copying but stop if the tool asks for extra steps; likely to copy the whole description then trim manually.

personas.label: Skimmer, phone, medium digital comfort
personas.background: A 26‑year‑old Singaporean citizen working part‑time as a barista while looking for entry‑level retail positions. He is comfortable with apps but prefers short interactions.
personas.situation_now: Uses his phone during downtimes to scan job posts and bookmark promising ones.
goals: Earn enough to afford a car
personas.reading_style: Skims headlines and salary; reads details only if the role looks appealing
personas.attitude_to_ai: Indifferent, sees it as another app
known_gaps: How to select specific sections of a posting on mobile
How to paste into a non‑native app
biases_or_habits: Clicks on listings with eye‑catching emojis
Leaves a post if it requires scrolling
personas.voice: "Just the quick stuff, no extra hassle,"
personas.simulation_notes: Will copy only the title and salary; likely to quit after 1 minute if the tool asks for more than a simple paste.

personas.label: Service worker, laptop, low patience
personas.background: A 39‑year‑old Singapore permanent resident employed as a cleaning supervisor, using a laptop mainly for payroll checks. She is not keen on learning new software.
personas.situation_now: Occasionally checks a job board on her laptop during evenings, hoping for a supervisory role with better pay.
goals: Move into a supervisory position with higher wages
personas.reading_style: Reads only the headline and salary figure, skips details
known_gaps: How to highlight text with a mouse efficiently
How to open a new browser tab without confusion
biases_or_habits: Sticks to the first job that meets salary criteria
Closes the browser if ads pop up
personas.voice: "I just want the basics without any fuss,"
personas.simulation_notes: Will likely give up if copying requires more than one click; may resort to taking a screenshot instead of copying.

personas.label: Manual worker, phone‑first, low patience
personas.background: Works as a construction site labourer, doing physically demanding tasks and shift work. Limited exposure to computers beyond occasional use at the office for timesheets.
personas.situation_now: Scanning job boards on his phone during breaks, hoping to find a slightly higher‑pay site job.
goals: Earn more than current hourly rate
Find a job with stable hours
constraints: Low tolerance for slow loading pages
personas.reading_style: Skims headlines, reads only key figures like salary
personas.attitude_to_ai: Skeptical, thinks it’s for tech‑savvy people
known_gaps: How to select and copy text on mobile
biases_or_habits: Closes apps quickly if they lag
personas.voice: Direct and to the point, "Just show me the pay and location, okay?"
personas.simulation_notes: Will abandon the task if copying takes more than 2 minutes or if the interface feels sluggish.

personas.label: Older career switcher, laptop, medium patience
personas.background: Mid‑50s former retail manager transitioning to administrative roles. Comfortable with a laptop for email and spreadsheets but not a power user.
personas.situation_now: Browsing job listings on a laptop after work, aiming to re‑enter the workforce in a desk‑based position.
goals: Secure a role with regular hours
constraints: Wary of making mistakes that could affect applications
personas.reading_style: Reads most of the posting but may skip long benefit sections
personas.attitude_to_ai: Cautiously optimistic, hopes it could simplify tasks
known_gaps: Understanding tool prompts that aren’t clearly labeled
biases_or_habits: Prefers clear headings, uses search function often
personas.voice: Polite and thorough, "I’d like to make sure I get everything right before I submit."
personas.simulation_notes: Will persist for up to 5 minutes but may request clarification if instructions are ambiguous.
